title: Clock Quest
summary: An island of train schedules, markets and a lighthouse; turn the clock hands to arrive at the right place at the right time.
mobileSupportNote: Full quest loop verified live at 390x844 (keyboard solve, pointer drag, board, recap, finale): stacked layout, full-width actions, 260px clock, generous invisible marker hit-areas. Drag precision is lower than tablet — steppers (with press-and-hold repeat) remain the primary fine input on small screens.

cover.alt: Staged teaching moment on the live app: the quest ticket open over the island chart with the station clock mid-lesson, amber measuring arc sweeping from 12 with 5-10-15 counting labels, 'Be there by 9:30 AM' readout and the big steppers

desktop.alt: Honest default landing at desktop width: nautical island chart with five stops on a dashed ferry route, compass rose, ferry token at the pier, journal panel reading 'Next stop — Ferry Pier' and the stamp passport in the header

tablet.alt: Hero tablet view: the island chart on top with the journal panel and its 'Sail there' call-to-action fully above the fold, morning progress '0 of 5 stops' in the journey bar

mobile.alt: Honest mobile landing at 390px: wrapped journal header with stamp passport, island chart scaled with all five markers and labels legible, journal panel stacked below
